item.title: Questions abound as Jalen Hurts likely to miss rest of season due to blood clots, sources say
item.description: League sources tell CBS Philadelphia that Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts is being sidelined, likely for the rest of the season, after testing revealed deep vein thrombosis and blood clots in his lungs.

item.title: LSU student describes alleged rape by football player, questions university's response
item.description: A criminal investigation is underway a year after a 19-year-old student at Louisiana State University says she was raped by a football player. CBS News' Jericka Duncan reports.

item.title: Starshield vs. Starlink: How Ukraine's military use both
item.description: Starshield has become essential for Ukrainian military operations. Jericka Duncan explains what it is and how it's related to Starlink.

item.title: Former Amb. William Taylor says Trump needs to put pressure on Putin, not Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has accused President Trump of not supporting Ukraine, but rather, pressuring them to capitulate to Russia. Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Zelenskyy says it's Putin who wants an endless war, not him
item.description: Ukraine's leader rejects Trump's accusations, says Putin is refusing peace, not him, and the U.S. military is delaying "vital supplies."

item.title: Air Force member dies in rappelling incident at UT San Antonio football game
item.description: A service member was injured and later died after falling while rappelling from the ceiling of the University of Texas at San Antonio football stadium on Saturday.

item.title: U.S. airman identified after death in rappelling incident before college football game
item.description: A ceremony ahead of a football game at the University of Texas at San Antonio went horribly wrong over the weekend when a U.S. airman was killed. CBS News correspondent Cristian Benavides has the latest.

item.title: NHL parents couldn't be prouder after son gets into fistfight during debut game
item.description: Dylan Peterson made his NHL debut last week on the St. Louis Blues. In the third period, he squared off and held his own. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

item.title: Jalen Hurts' devastating diagnosis rattles sports world
item.description: Jalen Hurts, star quarterback of the Philadelphia Eagles, may be out for the season after doctors discovered a serious blood clot that could have been life-threatening. Tom Hanson reports.

item.title: Pope Leo returns to work less than a week after lung cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo returned to work at the Vatican on Monday, less than a week after doctors removed a portion of his lung when a cancerous growth was discovered. Chris Livesay reports from Rome.

item.title: Feds probing suspicious letters to election officials, lawmakers
item.description: Federal investigators said they are looking into suspicious letters containing unknown substances that were mailed to state election officials and congressional offices.

item.title: Boy among 2 killed after truck drives onto Wichita soccer field
item.description: A 6-year-old boy and a 35-year-old man were killed during a soccer game at Stryker Soccer Complex in Wichita, Kansas, according to police.

item.title: Gun used in Bend school shooting was birthday gift from shooter's mom
item.description: The Maverick 88 pump-action 12-gauge shotgun was purchased legally in August 2026 by Shauntai Nickerson, the mother of the shooter, and given to him for recreational use, sources told CBS News.

item.title: Video shows police taking mother into custody after plowing through youth soccer game
item.description: Police are investigating why a mother in a pickup truck plowed through a youth soccer game in Kansas, killing two people, including a 6-year-old. Ian Lee reports with latest developments.

item.title: France vows to crack down after protests spiral out of control
item.description: French leaders call for local curfews and say an "ultra-left movement" was behind widespread violence and vandalism amid anti-government protests.

item.title: Texas Senate race close to tied between James Talarico, Ken Paxton, CBS News poll finds
item.description: With two weeks to the midterm elections, President Trump rejected worries about a tough year for Republicans ahead of a campaign trip to Kansas. Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: Plane engine shoots flames before takeoff from Lima, Peru
item.description: A flight from Lima, Peru, was canceled at the last second on Monday when flames started shooting from an engine. Kris Van Cleave reports on this and another plane mishap in Las Vegas.

item.title: France's leaders vow to restore order after violent weekend of riots
item.description: French officials have implemented some local curfews following a weekend of violent protests across the country. CBS News senior global affairs correspondent Trevor Phillips has more.

item.title: Powerful nor'easter bears down from Florida to New Jersey
item.description: A nor'easter kicked up massive waves along the Atlantic coast on Monday, putting over 8 million people from the Jersey Shore to Florida under alerts for coastal flooding and high surf. Rob Marciano reports and has the forecast.

item.title: Officer who shot 1-year-old while responding to shoplifting was justified, attorney general finds
item.description: A police officer who shot a 1-year-old boy while responding to a shoplifting call was justified in using deadly force, according to Mississippi's attorney general. Skyler Henry reports.

item.title: What to know about Europe protests after violence, looting
item.description: What began as a student-led protest over cuts to education spiraled into widespread arson, looting and what the French president called "unrestrained violence" over the weekend. Thousands were arrested and curfews went into effect on Monday. Aidan Stretch reports on what's fueling the violence and what's next.

item.title: Zelenskyy says Trump is on wrong side of history after dealings with Russia
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says he received no warnings ahead of Russia's overnight missile and drone strikes. Zelenskyy has accused the U.S. of limiting intelligence. CBS News' Charlie D'Agata has more.

item.title: Early voting begins in Texas as Trump campaigns in Kansas amid tight Senate race
item.description: President Trump is traveling to Kansas Monday to campaign for Republican Roger Hamilton. Hamilton is locked in a close Senate race with Democrat Adam Hamilton. CBS News' Katrina Kaufman reports.

item.title: Transcript: Rep. Mike Turner on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan," Oct. 18, 2026
item.description: The following is the transcript of the interview with Rep. Mike Turner, Republican of Ohio, that aired on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" on Oct. 18, 2026.

item.title: Sen. Raphael Warnock calls on Democrats to focus on the South
item.description: Georgia Democratic Sen. Raphael Warnock says his party can win throughout the South, but only with sustained investment in the region. New York Times reporter Ken Vogel and Washington Sun senior editor Dave Levinthal join "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: 1 person killed in shooting near Columbus, Ohio, mosque
item.description: A fatal shooting outside a mosque in Columbus, Ohio, was not an attack on the building, police said.

item.title: 10/19: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: President Trump stumping for Sen. Roger Marshall in Kansas; new CBS News poll shows tight Senate race in Texas.

item.title: As AI dominates conversations, here are key terms to know
item.description: Artificial intelligence and the conversations around it are rapidly evolving. These terms can help to understand the developments.

item.title: The AI doom scenario you've never heard of may be hardest to stop
item.description: The time to prepare for "gradual disempowerment" is now, according to researchers. One calls it "a civilization-scale problem."

item.title: Oregon school shooter ID'd, used shotgun bought by mother, sources say
item.description: The suspect, a former student at the school, fired as many as 15 rounds during the shooting, police said, and another 44 rounds of ammunition were located at the scene.
